## Publication checklist

- [ ] Content is original and examples use synthetic data.
- [ ] No Grid Health source code, secrets, customer data, private business information, or derivatives were used.
- [ ] Every added file and the complete diff have been reviewed.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_publication.py` passes.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_library.py` and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Resource entry fields identify the use case, output, and recheck needs.
- [ ] Research dates changed only for sources actually rechecked.
- [ ] INDEX.md is updated and technical claims are supported.
- [ ] Any untested examples or other limitations are stated.
